preregistration.reference: B, the unchanged previous ranking (production has no calm speech guard), on identical seeds.
preregistration.gates: The Phase 2J.1 gates, unchanged, applied to N against B. Calm: B's calm lists contain speech-like tracks whose spread inflates their diversity (Phase 2H.8.1); no adjustment is made for that, so the calm configuration is compared as-is. Calm speech-like share must be <= 0.20 and <= B's.
resolved: Single-target gates use within-target diversity (equal to list diversity for one target).
Configurations N serves exactly as B (angry, stressed, all five uplift mixes) have zero paired differences: not a gain for the 4-of-6 count, and they pass no-regression and non-inferiority.
Legacy mean classifier probability >= 0.99 is reported, not applied.
V is a diagnostic: reported against B but never gated.
preregistration.seeds: Gates on 36000-36049; replication 39000-39049 reported, and a gate it fails is flagged as not replicated. Both disjoint from every earlier seed set.

gates.integrity: 100% target consistency, exact shares in every list, same-seed determinism on all 12 requests

notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity, not listener-perceived variety.
Bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability over 50 seeded runs on one catalog only.
Harness latency for B and N includes building the result DataFrame; V returns row positions only, so its latency is not comparable.
N's first routed call in a process builds the feature cells; the cold-start figures include it.
